const got = port.rebuild(requested, keepLives);

killedBy: runDevAction: what it reports, and when it refuses reports the seed the WORLD is running, not the one it asked for
why: Reports the REQUESTED seed rather than the one the world was built with, whenever a seed was requested. That is the difference between an action and a claim: a session can resolve a request differently -- something outranking it, a clamp, a refusal -- and a pane echoing its own intention states a number no world was ever built from. It is also the number that goes into the reproduction URL beside it, so the wrong one reproduces nothing.
